v01.text: Six times eight? Split it. Solve it.

v02.text: Here are six rows of eight donuts.

v03.text: Split the six rows into two equal groups.

v04.text: Are the two groups the same?

v05.text: Yes. Three rows of eight in each.

v06.text: Three rows of eight make twenty-four.

v07.text: The other group is the same.

v09.text: So six times eight is forty-eight.

v10.text: For a six fact, find the three fact, then double it.

v11.text: Play and learn tables with Table Verse.
